1000:3acc.name: InstallTimerHandlers
1000:3acc.plate_comment: Installs IRQ08h handler at CS:3b17 and INT24h handler at CS:3b14; preserves the old IRQ08h vector in self-modified far-jump operands CS:3b67/3b69. Programs PIT channel 0 in mode 3 with divisor 0x19e4 (6628). IRQ phase DS:3192 counts 9..0; gameplay counter DS:1600 increments at phases 5 and 0, so one physics counter increment every five IRQs. Nominal PC PIT clock 1193182 Hz yields 180.0214 IRQ/s and 36.0043 physics ticks/s. Clock frequency is an emulator/PC model, not a measurement. Verified installer port/IVT writes and 1324 phase/stream IRQ cases against original code; analysis/skyroads/timer-validation.json.

1000:66e6.name: DecodeLzsBlock
1000:66e6.plate_comment: Verified resource decoder: Python port matched all31 ROADS.LZS streams (60872 bytes) against isolated replay of these unchanged x86 instructions. Header bytes are length_bits, short_distance_bits, long_distance_bits. MSB-first tokens: 0=short match(distance=read(short)+2), 10=long match(distance=read(long)+(1<<short)+2), 11=8-bit literal. Match length=read(length_bits)+2; overlapping forward copy. Patches widths at6729,671f,674c and long-distance base at6751. Far destination BP+4, output length BP+8. Buffer byte alignment on exit. Runtime helpers require SS=DS. Python rejects malformed streams more strictly than original; equivalence is verified on the31 valid road streams, not all possible inputs. See analysis/skyroads/lzs-validation.json.

1000:186b.name: ResolveShipMovement
1000:186b.plate_comment: Verified integer port in scripts/skyroads_movement.py, differential evidence in movement-validation.json (1970 resolver cases; every intermediate collision probe compared). Near C arguments: targetForwardLow, targetForwardHigh, targetLateral, targetHeight. Reads/writes DS:9618/961a forward32, DS:af1c lateral16, DS:af2c height16. Five fractional movement probes; keeps the last clear fraction; refines forward by4096/256/16/1, then lateral and height by signed125/25/5/1. Fractional lateral/height products wrap16 BEFORE signed division by5; forward product wraps32. Division truncates toward zero. Axis order is observable. Forward refinement uses an unsigned remaining distance and assumes ordinary forward motion. Host port bounds road allocation/probes; no general swept-collision or full game-loop equivalence claim.

1000:1ccd.name: PredictSafeLanding
1000:1ccd.plate_comment: Verified integer port and complete projected-flight traces (1408 direct prediction cases plus calls inside519 assist cases). Near C args: forward32, lateral16, height16, speed32, signedSteering16, signedVerticalSpeed16. Uses DS:54aa gravity, DS:5496 lateral drift, DS:9330 acceleration input. Each step adds gravity to vertical speed, advances forward by current speed, lateral by signed32((speed+1560)*steering)/512+drift, rejects x outside inclusive12160..53376, adds vertical speed to height, clamps speed+75*input to0..10922. Stops at unsigned height<=10240, then tests previous/current tiles with IsUnsafeLandingTile. Does not execute collision resolution or test intermediate walls/roofs. AX=0/1; globals unchanged. See MOVEMENT-FORMAT.md.

1000:1dfa.name: AdjustJumpForSafeLanding
1000:1dfa.plate_comment: Verified against unchanged x86, including candidate order and all prediction traces (519 direct cases). Tests current projected landing first. If unsafe, for n=1..6 tries steering +/- trunc16(steering*n)/10, then speed +/- trunc32(speed*n)/10. Faster candidate tested only if signed speed<10922 (strict); first accepted candidate wins. Uses current position, vertical speed and environment globals. Writes steering DS:4568, speed DS:54ac/54ae, speed delta DS:af2e/af30, success flag DS:455a. An immediately safe prediction preserves existing flag/delta. Exhausting trials restores original steering/speed, writes delta0 and preserves flag. Helper purpose supported by caller and exact replay; gameplay triggering conditions remain to be reconstructed.

1000:3b17.name: HandleTimerInterrupt
1000:3b17.plate_comment: IRQ08h handler recovered from InstallTimerHandlers vector. Preserves general registers and DS, sets DS from relocated CS:3aca, then calls audio stream service 5a55. When byte DS:3192 is 0 or 5, increments word DS:1600 and feeds the speaker PIT from word [DS:bd0], advancing that pointer for nonzero words. Decrements phase; signed-negative result resets phase to 9 and far-jumps to old BIOS handler via CS:3b67/3b69. Other phases emit PIC EOI and IRET. Normal 9..0 cycle has one gameplay tick each 5 IRQs and one BIOS chain each 10. All 256 phase byte values, counter wrap, port outputs and restored registers compared; audio service idle-delay branch only, old BIOS execution excluded. See timer-validation.json and TIMER-FORMAT.md.
